inlineExceptions.reason: Lexer tests intentionally construct malformed token fragments; text construction is the behavior under test.
Parser tests intentionally construct narrow syntax snippets and malformed statements; text construction is the behavior under test.
Binding tests construct narrow switch diagnostic inputs inline to isolate literal comparison behavior.
Multi-file tests intentionally construct per-case source filenames, source order, and version substitutions to assert compilation-wide diagnostics.
Library emission tests retain inline source where the source filename, PDB option, and emitted-library metadata are the behavior under test.
In-memory execution tests retain source construction where BOM, stream truncation, and byte-preserving source construction are the behavior under test.
PDB tests retain source construction where exact source line numbers and temporary source filenames are asserted.
Debugger smoke test retains source construction because the temporary source path and sequence points are asserted.
Debugger protocol tests retain source construction because generated paths and source line mapping are asserted.
Web runner tests retain source construction where dynamic output limits and diagnostic locations are asserted.
The test does not construct source; it verifies the application-owned sample catalog retains complete sample boundaries.
